title: Bytes offers free APIs to access 100K+ AI models plus a GitHub repo #bytesapi #freeapi #aimodels
description: Bytes revealed three free alternative AI API tools and a secret GitHub repo that can drastically reduce costs on paid API keys. These include Bytes, the largest inference API platform with access to over 100,000 open source AI models, Nvidia Nymph offering 80 top AI models with rate limits, and Open Router providing free API keys for popular models like Quen and Lama. The GitHub repository compiles these free API providers and offers one-click configuration snippets, enabling seamless integration with platforms like Claude Code, Courser, and Codex. This innovation empowers developers and AI enthusiasts to access a diverse range of AI models without hefty expenses, fostering broader adoption and experimentation. Such open access tools highlight the growing trend toward democratizing AI development and reducing financial barriers. By leveraging these resources, businesses and individuals can accelerate AI integration and innovation at significantly lower costs. #BytesAPI #NvidiaNymph #OpenRouter #FreeAIModels #AIAPI #OpenSourceAI #GitHubRepo #ClaudeCode #CourserAI #CodexIntegration #AIDevelopment #AIInnovation #ArtificialIntelligence #TechTools #AIForEveryone
